user_query: I'm planning a romantic dinner and I want to create a playlist of love songs. Can you fetch a playlist from Spotify and provide me with the details? I would also like to retrieve the lyrics for these songs from the SongMeanings API.

TaskList.description: Fetch a playlist of love songs from Spotify.
Retrieve the details of the fetched playlist from Spotify.
Extract the song titles from the playlist to retrieve their lyrics.
Fetch the lyrics for each song from the SongMeanings API.
